body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung exhibited its Andriod smartphone 'Moment' at CES 2010.
It has an 800MHz processor, a 3.2-inch AMOLED screen, optical trackpad and a 3.2 megapixel camera. It will be launched through a trial this spring in Washington DC.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
